title: Additional Tariffs on Imported Goods and Suspension of Duty-Free Customs Entry
summary: U.S. Customs and Border Protection implements additional import duties and removes duty-free treatment for affected low-value shipments, so those shipments now require a full customs entry and owe tariffs. Businesses that import finished goods or components face higher landed costs and added paperwork.
full_text: U.S. Customs and Border Protection has implemented additional tariffs on a broad set of imported goods and removed duty-free treatment for affected low-value shipments. Importers must now file a full customs entry and pay the applicable import duties and tariffs at the time of entry rather than relying on prior duty-free handling. The action raises landed costs and adds customs-entry recordkeeping for businesses that import finished consumer goods or hardware components for resale.
